This '''Savrip Warmaker''' served as the tribal leader of a group of [[Mantellian Savrip/Legends|Mantellian Savrips]] who fought against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].

==Biography==
At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebels]] led by [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] believed that the [[Mantellian Savrip/Legends|Mantellian Savrips]] had an old decryption module vital to their plans to keep the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] away from their [[Echo Base/Legends|hidden base]]. So the princess sent [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and a team of [[Rebel trooper/Legends|rebel troopers]] to make contact with them. However, on their way to the Savrip lair, the rebel squad was ambushed by a patrol of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. Later, the Savrip Warmaker and a group of Savrip [[warrior]]s joined the attack, killing both imperial troopers and rebels, believing the rebels were also Imperials. The Savrips found a damaged C-3PO, which they dismembered and took its parts to their lair.<ref name="Assault Team" />

When [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] arrived on Ord Mantell, in order to retrieve the decryption module, they meet with Leia, who told them what happened. So, they went to search for the rebel troopers that survived the ambush, in order to get more information on C-3PO's whereabouts. After rescuing the rebels and following a trail, left by the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid's]] [[Limb/Legends|limbs]], the rebel heroes found the Savrip lair, where Threepio's remains were located. However, the Savrip Warmaker found them and ordered his warriors to attack the intruders, believing they were also Imperials. During the waves of assaults, Luke managed to repair C-3PO. The droid told the Savrip leader to stop his attack and explained to him that, in fact, they were rebels who were fighting the Empire and came to Ord Mantell in order to get an decryption module. Realizing that he did a mistake, he apologized to the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]], and agreed to help them, by telling them where the module was located.<ref name="Assault Team" />
